title: Polite Requests
npcIntro: Politeness is a superpower at the counter. Let's level it up.
npcOutro: Beautiful — you sound like a regular now.

exercises.prompt: Which is the most polite way to ask for water?
choices: Could I have some water, please?
exercises.phraseCard: Could I have some water, please?

exercises.prompt: I'd ____ have tea than coffee, if you don't mind.

choices: I don't want any milk in my coffee.
I don't want no milk in my coffee.
I want no any milk in my coffee.
I don't want some milk in my coffee.

exercises.prompt: I'll wait for you ____ the café entrance at six.
exercises.phraseCard: at the entrance / on the corner / in the café
Could I possibly have a refill, please?

exercises.prompt: You hear: "I'll have the same, thanks." — what does the speaker mean?
choices: The same thing the previous customer ordered.
A drink that costs the same as last time.
The same size as their friend's.
